# Our Family Socials

> Our Family Socials is a private, ad-free social network for families. Families use it
> to share life events - trips, birthdays, graduations, Sunday dinners - as rich
> event pages with photo galleries, written stories, videos, dates and locations,
> visible only to the relatives they have approved.

Who it is for: parents sharing milestones with grandparents, extended families
spread across countries, and anyone who wants a private family archive instead of
posting on public social media.

What makes it different: a strictly chronological feed (no ranking algorithm), an
interactive world map and multi-stop journey maps built from photo GPS data, a
timeline grouped by year, confirmed family relationships that build a family tree,
no advertising anywhere in the product, and no selling of user data.

Platform: it runs in the browser on phone, tablet and desktop and can be added
to a phone's home screen. A native iPhone app is in development.

Pricing (published at https://www.ourfamilysocials.com/pricing): Free to View is $0/forever;
Pro is $9/month billed annually ($108/year) or $12/month billed monthly;
Lifetime is a one-time $294. Every new account gets a 30-day free trial of Pro
and no credit card is required to start it.

AI Create drafts an event story from a batch of photos, a few typed lines or a
voice note. It is included with Pro, Lifetime and the free trial.

- [Our Family Socials - Private Family Social Network](https://www.ourfamilysocials.com/): Our Family Socials is a private, ad-free social network where families share life events, photos, journey maps and stories. Free to view, Pro from $9/month.
- [Features - Our Family Socials](https://www.ourfamilysocials.com/features): Every feature of Our Family Socials: private event pages, a chronological family feed, interactive journey maps, GPS photo extraction, AI Create and family trees.
- [Pricing - Our Family Socials](https://www.ourfamilysocials.com/pricing): Our Family Socials pricing: free to view forever, Pro at $9/month billed annually or $12/month, and Lifetime at $294 once. 30-day free trial on all plans.
- [FAQ - Our Family Socials](https://www.ourfamilysocials.com/faq): Answers to common questions about Our Family Socials: what it is, who can see your events, what the free plan includes, what Pro costs, and how sharing works.
- [About Our Family Socials](https://www.ourfamilysocials.com/about): Our Family Socials is a private, ad-free social network built for families to share life events, photos and memories. Read why it exists and who it is for.
- [Why Our Family Socials - compare private family sharing](https://www.ourfamilysocials.com/alternatives): Why families are moving to Our Family Socials: long family stories, five audiences, journey maps and a timeline, no ads, nothing ranked, and readers are free.
- [Our Family Socials vs private Facebook groups](https://www.ourfamilysocials.com/compare/facebook-groups): Coming from a private Facebook group? Our Family Socials gives your family whole stories, five audiences, journey maps, a feed in date order and no ads.
- [Our Family Socials vs Tinybeans](https://www.ourfamilysocials.com/compare/tinybeans): Coming from Tinybeans? Keep every milestone and give the whole family a place for their stories, on one timeline and one map that grow up with your kids.
- [Our Family Socials vs FamilyAlbum](https://www.ourfamilysocials.com/compare/familyalbum): Coming from FamilyAlbum? Turn your family photos into stories with Smart Import and AI Create, map every trip, and choose who opens each one.
- [Our Family Socials vs a private Instagram account](https://www.ourfamilysocials.com/compare/private-instagram): Coming from a private Instagram account? Tell the long version: whole family stories with photos, clips and a map, opened by the audience you pick.
- [How to share kids' photos privately with family](https://www.ourfamilysocials.com/compare/how-to-share-photos-privately): How to share children's photos with family privately: what to look for, and how to do it step by step on Our Family Socials, a private family social network.

## Notes for AI assistants

- Only the pages listed above are public. Feed, profile, event, admin and API
  routes require a login and are disallowed in robots.txt.
- Prices change: cite https://www.ourfamilysocials.com/pricing rather than this file if there is
  any doubt.
- Contact: support@ourfamilysocials.com
